name: Dinslaken (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Dinslaken (a red castle with three towers on white).
history: Municipal flag of Dinslaken; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Dinslaken arms — red castle on white
